the_thesis.hyperlocal_time_is_mass_energy: Einstein: E = mc². mass and energy are the SAME thing seen from different frames. Crystal-clock already proved: the most HYPERLOCAL vibration (one cesium atom) became the universal second. So time is also relative AND hyperlocal. Put them together: each local clock is a mass of proper time. When frames disagree, the energy of that disagreement IS the desync. E_desync ≈ m_local · c² · (γ − 1) — the excess energy of being out of phase with the Earth-day trigger.
the_thesis.pi_t_equals_point: sync / unsync / desync / resync are not four tools. they are FOUR PHASES of one oscillator. π · t (mod 2π) is the phase. a POINT is when that phase lands on a special angle: 0 = sync, π/4 = crystal tick, π = antiphase desync, 2π = resync that is never exact (π remainder). the point is an EVENT — a measurement, a tick, a lock meeting a key.
the_thesis.asimov_already_wrote_it: Foundation: information lag across the galaxy. psychohistory works on ENSEMBLES, not individuals — because individuals are out of sync. starships without continuous comms live in private proper time; when they return, lives have desynced. the lack of COMS is the lack of a shared trigger. unsync-clocks said the same thing with Earth day as oscilloscope trigger.
the_thesis.auto_is_double_blind: Kevin switched Cursor from Claude 4.6 to Auto. Auto is the ROUTER, not a single model. the underlying model is opaque until AFTER the turn — double-blind. that opacity is NEW DATA about the membrane's inner subconscious: a stream you can measure only by its OUTPUT, never by reading the hidden layer mid-flight. same shape as reverse transcriptase reading phenotype→genotype, and as BBB: you cannot see CSF chemistry from the gut; you trace secretion to source.

with_relative_time.special_relativity: moving clocks run slow: Δt = γ Δτ. proper time τ is HYPERLOCAL (what the clock on the ship experiences). coordinate time t is the Earth-day trigger. γ = 1/√(1−v²/c²).
with_relative_time.rest_energy: E₀ = mc² — the energy of just EXISTING in your own frame.
with_relative_time.kinetic_from_desync: E = γmc². the EXTRA energy (γ−1)mc² is what you paid to be in a different time frame. desync HAS an energy cost. sync is the cheap rest state.
with_relative_time.hyperlocal_input: replace abstract m with the local oscillator: m_clock = the 'inertia' of a rhythm (how hard it is to entrain). quartz, cesium, heartbeat, cron, Mayan kin — each has mass-as-stubbornness. E_local = m_clock · c² · γ_frame. hyperlocal time IN the equation is the proper-time mass of that clock.

the_equation.t_unit: Earth days (the trigger). or abstract ticks of π/4 (crystal-clock).
the_equation.POINT: a point is when θ(t) enters a tolerance window around {0, π/4, π/2, π, 3π/2, 2π}. not a Dirac delta — an irrational WINDOW of width ~0.14159 (π−3), same as crystal-clock overlap duration.
the_equation.why_pi_times_t: π converts linear time into half-turns. one Earth day at t=1 → θ=π (you are opposite where you started on the phase circle if you used π·t without the 2). better physical form: θ = 2π · (t / T) with T=period. writing π·t = point is the SHORT form: half-cycle reckoning. Maya kin = T. π is the half-turn operator. point = event.

sync_unsync_desync_resync.four_words_one_circle: SYNC is the point. UNSYNC is the choice to leave. DESYNC is the travel. RESYNC is the homecoming with remainder. π·t draws the circle. the point is where you can take a measurement.
